novelty_basis: Elementary; implicit in the quasigroup-string-processing literature.
proof_check: Lean 4 + Mathlib for the persistence of differences (eT_ne_of_ne; standard axioms only); agreement before i and the corollary by written proof (proofs/paper/C18.md Theorem 2); 0 violations on 7 x 2000 random strings (EXP-C18-01); max bias 0.5 for all three forward-only variants (EXP-C18-02)
statement: If u and v differ exactly at position i, then e_l(u) and e_l(v) agree at positions < i and differ at every position >= i. Consequently, in a hash that outputs the last 8 bytes of forward e-transformations only, changing a message byte at position i >= n - 8 leaves the earlier tail bytes unchanged, so some output bits never flip and the maximal avalanche bias is 1/2.
title: Differences propagate forward only; forward-only tail hashes fail the strict avalanche criterion
